items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: I remember, I think I met him... We met but I never played with him.

ctx.x: – for me, as an extremely low income freelance crazy kid, that provided some income which for me was wonderful. Because we would do a tour – I was trying to think, because I was thinking about Sheila – we did a tour in ’84, in ’83 and ’84, and ’87, and ’88, and maybe one or two more, and then in ’90 or ’91 I did one more that I was invited to, and that was the one that was with Quincy and Miles at Montreux where they combined forces or the George Gruntz band and the Gil Evans, re-formed Gil Evans band with Gil…
I wonder if you ever played with Alvin Queen over there?

I remember, I think I met him and I know he was busy in that sort of expatriate world of I guess Switzerland. Maybe he was in Geneva, I forget for sure, or Lausanne. We met but I never played with him.
